dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Identified three prominent closed 'O' shaped rings on the mid-lateral flank and one large open 'C' shaped structure on the upper dorsal surface; perimeters exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior fur to lighter, mottled interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior dorsal region near the neck and lower ventral-lateral margin; these lack internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary lateral 'O' rings and the dorsal 'C' ring form an irregular quadrilateral; the dorsal 'C' ring and the two most anterior lateral rings form a scalene triangle.
